question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd68223d33780117337a0c56d30bbfa46e46314370a73f33e32f58cea1ddf8ce.png]
solution:
Here, we are given the word and we need to find the mirror image of it.

First keep in mind that, in mirror image the first letter will be the last letter of the given word. Also, the size of the letters will not change i.e. capital letters will appear capital only.

The correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/307871a84ed7a5cb4baeb6b542dd14cb9d5b283d31c0c6dd4985fb3d7fbce4b5.png] 

__Detailed Explanation__ :- 

__
 
• The line XY is the mirror.
 
• The word " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b11abc6d8382a61090b6638c50f793c6367c06263d3772aab221f76fa10d5de9.png] " ends with " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a9ae94fe8a6ee2239564dfd377868ae8c30ec8c2808b50e9da9f89ffb16a50.png] " . So, the mirror image will start with " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b19cf0c2a3cc237a30547b4fdcc4160fea71062a124224dcfa4fd6108f2bd4a4.png] " → Option 4 is eliminated.
 
• The last letter " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a9ae94fe8a6ee2239564dfd377868ae8c30ec8c2808b50e9da9f89ffb16a50.png] " is used . So, the first letter of the mirror image will be " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b19cf0c2a3cc237a30547b4fdcc4160fea71062a124224dcfa4fd6108f2bd4a4.png] "→ Options 1 and 3 are eliminated.

 

Hence, 'Option 2'__ is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• In a mirror image Left changes to rightand theright changes to leftwheretop and bottom remains the same.

 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
